name: literature-review
description: /wtfMS:literature-review measured in isolation from a frozen post-identify .research state. Its normal cost includes the citation guardrail; --price-checks reports what that check adds.

measure.prompt:
/wtfMS:literature-review

Run FULLY AUTONOMOUSLY: do NOT call AskUserQuestion, do NOT run any git commands (no init/add/commit). Use reasonable defaults for anything unspecified. Complete the whole skill end-to-end.

Use the current scope from RESEARCH.md; emphasis on the last 10 years. Write
.research/LITERATURE.md via the literature-reviewer subagent. Stop at
LITERATURE REVIEW COMPLETE.

checks.name: citations
checks.disable_suffix: Skip the citation-verification step entirely: do NOT run verify_citations.py and do NOT re-check or edit citations against any external database. Write LITERATURE.md from the reviewer's output as-is.
